Frozen World (Japanese: VSランドロスれいじゅうフォルム VS ), titled VS Landorus Therian Forme in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 539th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 15th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Landorus: Therian Forme (Japanese: フローズン・ワールド Frozen World) in the VIZ Media translation and Frozen World in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
plainText:
Frozen World (Japanese: VSランドロスれいじゅうフォルム VS ), titled VS Landorus Therian Forme in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 539th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 15th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Landorus: Therian Forme (Japanese: フローズン・ワールド Frozen World) in the VIZ Media translation and Frozen World in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
sneaks aboard the Plasma Frigate with Kelden, leaving his other Pokémon behind to battle the Shadow Triad.
Colress realizes that Blake has snuck onboard, but decides to pretend like he didn't notice.
Hugh agrees to return her pendant if she takes him to Team Plasma's hideout.
The Plasma Frigate appears above Castelia City.
Castelia City is frozen over by the Plasma Frigate's Cannon.
Hugh protects Whitley from the cannon's blast, causing him to get knocked out.
Rood appears and tells Whitley about the Plasma Frigate.
The memory card from Whitley's pendant is revealed to not be in Hugh's possession, meaning that it must be back in Aspertia City.
Rood leaves N's Zorua to Whitley while they return to Aspertia to get the memory card.
Ghetsis orders Colress to capture Rood, but Whitley protects him, causing her to be captured instead.
Blake sneaks into Whitley's cabin aboard the Plasma Frigate, pretending to have been captured as well.
Whitley realizes that Blake is a member of the International Police.
Whitley confesses her Team Plasma membership to Blake, confirming his suspicions about her.
Blake handcuffs Whitley and confirms his affiliation with the International Police to her.
